slice.finding: Cargo documents net.offline as a boolean (default false, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE) that, when true, avoids network access and attempts to proceed with locally cached data; it can also be overridden with the --offline command-line option.
slice.verified_scope: Documentation semantics of net.offline at the pinned Cargo source ref only.
slice.not_verified_scope: No Cargo command execution, cache completeness, dependency resolution success, vendor population, source replacement behavior, git dependency behavior, or other public source was tested in this invocation.

phase1_assessment.reason: The documented control is useful evidence for explicitly suppressing network access, but it does not itself provide scheduled-Chat-native execution or guarantee required package data already exists locally.
phase1_assessment.positive_evidence_scope: Cargo exposes an explicit network-off switch that attempts to use local cache only; this is not evidence of end-to-end Chat parity.

scope_guard: Do not broaden this finding into a claim that Cargo offline mode guarantees successful builds, fetches, or dependency resolution without a pre-populated local cache/source.
